name: Lustr
tagline: The operating system for verified industrial cleaning at scale.
positioning: Lustr turns messy clipboards and photo threads into auditable, sensor-verified clean-cycles across every plant, warehouse, and processing floor you run.

hero.h1: Every clean, logged. Every floor, proven.
hero.sub: Lustr coordinates crews, schedules, and IoT verification so your facilities team can prove a surface was actually sanitized — not just marked done on a clipboard.

features.title: Sensor-verified clean-cycles
features.description: Pair ATP swabs and area sensors to each task so a completed job carries proof, not a promise. No more he-said-she-said before an audit.

features.title: Crew routing that flexes
features.description: Auto-build nightly routes across zones by contamination risk, downtime windows, and crew certs. Reroute in seconds when a line goes down early.

features.title: Compliance packets on demand
features.description: Export a timestamped, photo-backed sanitation log for FDA, OSHA, or a customer audit in one click — filtered to the exact date and line.

features.title: Chemical usage tracking
features.description: Meter every gallon of degreaser and sanitizer against the surface it touched, so reorders and dilution ratios stop being guesswork.

features.title: Downtime-aware scheduling
features.description: Sync with your MES to schedule deep cleans only inside real production gaps, cutting overtime and missed sanitation windows.

features.title: Multi-site rollups
features.description: Compare sanitation SLAs across 3 plants or 300 from one board, and drill into the one zone that keeps failing verification.

testimonials.quote: Before Lustr, our third-shift sanitation records were a stack of laminated checklists. Now a customer audit that used to eat two days takes an afternoon, and every clean has a swab result attached.
testimonials.name: Danielle Ochoa

testimonials.quote: We cut sanitizer spend 19% in the first quarter just by seeing where crews were over-dosing. The routing engine paid for itself before the chemical savings even showed up.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: The metered pricing was the unlock for finance. We only pay for verified square footage, so onboarding a fourth distribution center didn't mean renegotiating a giant seat contract.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: For single-site teams putting their first floors on proof-based cleaning.
Volume-tiered rates for operators running verified cleaning across many zones.
For national footprints with strict audit and data-residency needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Lustr is the verified-cleaning platform for industrial operators who have to prove it, not just do it. Built for facilities, food safety, and ops teams.
